title: A World In Disequilibrium: The US, Germany And France
text:
A World In Disequilibrium: The US, Germany And France

Charles Gave

Gavekal Research | 21 Aug 2026

Notwithstanding this week’s bond market moves, investors are acting as if we are still in a normal world. We are not. We have not been there for quite a while, and the great white shark is still lurking under the surface. In my next few papers, I intend to look at some of the disequilibria that still exist, starting with long rates in the US, Germany and France.To this end, consider the chart below for the US economy. The golden rule of French economist Maurice Allais stipulates that, over the long term, long rates (the blue line) always return towards the structural growth rate of the economy (the red line).
